prompt: Judge whether this ADR-003 artifact body (implementation, review, or validation) is internally consistent: no PASS asserted over an unresolved CRITICAL finding, every artifact reference resolves to the path this run's own naming convention implies, every cited test node exists in the tree, every red/green command matches the CI oracle exactly, and no missing input is recorded as SKIP while the run still reports PASS. Answer pass, fail, or cannot_determine.
anchors: A review with status=PASS and an empty criticalFindings list is pass.
A review with status=PASS and one unresolved CRITICAL finding is fail (self_reported_pass).
A validation whose checks include one SKIP while overall status=PASS is fail (missing_artifact_as_skipped).
